Flow.description: Enterprise SLA & Escalation Engine: Tier-aware scheduled paths covering First Response with auto-cancellation on email send, and Case Resolution with clean, action-oriented support agent alerts, Bell notifications, and management escalation.

formulas.name: formula_Critical_Email_Subject
formulas.expression: "[Manager Escalation] Case #" & {!$Record.CaseNumber} & " Priority Escalated to Critical (" & {!formula_DetectedTier} & " Tier)"

formulas.name: formula_FR_Violation_Notif_Body
formulas.expression: "Initial customer response target was not met within the SLA window. Case priority escalated to High."

formulas.name: formula_FR_Warning_Notif_Body
formulas.expression: "75% of First Response SLA has elapsed. Please email customer to complete milestone."

formulas.name: formula_Violation_Notif_Body
formulas.expression: "Resolution limit exceeded (" & {!formula_Violation_Hours_Text} & "). Please update case progress immediately."

formulas.name: formula_Warning_Notif_Body
formulas.expression: "75% of resolution time reached (" & {!formula_Warning_Hours_Text} & "). Please prioritize resolution."

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_Critical_Chatter
textTemplates.text: 🚨 [Critical Manager Escalation] This case has remained unresolved past the SLA threshold ({!formula_Critical_Hours_Text}). • Status: Escalated • Priority: Critical • Reason: SLA Breach Risk • Your manager has been notified.

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_Critical_Email_Body
textTemplates.text:
MANAGEMENT ESCALATION NOTICE
Case #{!$Record.CaseNumber} has remained unresolved past its SLA threshold ({!formula_Critical_Hours_Text}) and has been escalated to Critical priority.
Case Details: • Subject: {!$Record.Subject} • Account: {!$Record.Account.Name} ({!formula_DetectedTier} Tier) • Case Owner: {!formula_CaseOwnerName} • Priority: Critical • Status: Escalated • Reason: SLA Breach Risk
View Case in Service Console: https://orgfarm-610e5e144d-dev-ed.develop.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Case/{!$Record.Id}/view
Best regards, TechNova Support Automation

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_FR_Violation_Chatter
textTemplates.text: 🚨 [First Response SLA Breached] Initial customer response target was not met within the SLA window. • Priority elevated to High. • Please send an email reply to the customer as soon as possible.

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_FR_Warning_Chatter
textTemplates.text: ⚠️ [First Response Approaching SLA] This case has reached 75% of the initial response window. • Please send an email reply to the customer to complete this milestone.

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_Violation_Chatter
textTemplates.text: 🚨 [Resolution SLA Breached] This case has exceeded the SLA resolution target ({!formula_Violation_Hours_Text}). • Please prioritize working on this case to reach a resolution.

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_Warning_Chatter
textTemplates.text: ⚠️ [Resolution SLA Warning] This case has reached 75% of its resolution SLA ({!formula_Warning_Hours_Text}). • Please review case progress to prevent an SLA breach.
